provenance.notes: Verified on the official ACL formatting page: A4, two columns, 2.5 cm margins, Times 11 pt (title 15 pt bold, section 12 pt bold, captions and abstract 10 pt), review versions have page numbers and a line ruler, long papers up to 8 pages of content for review (9 final), short papers 4 (5), references unlimited. Style files in github.com/acl-org/acl-style-files: acl.sty, acl_latex.tex, acl_natbib.bst. The review-mode option name is NOT stated on the pages checked (`[review]` is the usual one, unverified).

limits.text: Long papers: 8 pages of content for review, 9 final. Short papers: 4 for review, 5 final. References unlimited; appendices do not count.

anonymity.text: Review versions have no acknowledgments; appendices follow the same anonymity rules.

facts.text: A4, two columns, 2.5 cm margins, Times 11 pt.
Long paper 8 pages for review, short paper 4.
Style files acl.sty / acl_natbib.bst at github.com/acl-org/acl-style-files.
Review version: page numbers and ruler; no acknowledgments.
